home.about_description: ChordProject is your pocket digital songbook: write, organize, and play your songs with chords in ChordPro format, on any device.
features: Chords always perfectly aligned, on any screen or font size.
Live mode, with autoscroll and quick font size adjustment.
Your repertoire saved online and synced across all your devices.
You can transpose songs according to musical rules, not just mathematical shifting.
home.platform_description: Visit our sister site HomenaJesus.com.
home.contribute_title: Have an idea to improve it?
home.contribute_description: It's an open source project - send your Pull Request on GitHub. Don't code? You can use AI to help write it.

songbook_page.title: Songbooks
songbook_page.description: You have four ways to work with your songbooks:
songbook_page.option_create: Create a new songbook that belongs only to you.
songbook_page.option_use_official: Use an official songbook as it is; you do not need to do anything else.
songbook_page.option_suggest: Suggest a change to an official songbook. The team will perform a brief review before applying it.
songbook_page.option_copy: As a last resort, create a copy of the official songbook. You can adapt it your way, but it will no longer receive the original's updates or synchronization.
songbook_page.hj_description: These songbooks are kept up to date. If you need to add or remove songs, create a personal songbook; if a song is missing for everyone, you can suggest adding it to the official one.
songbook_page.empty_personal: You do not have personal songbooks yet. Create a new one when you need your own selection; for official songbooks, use the original or suggest changes.
songbook_page.copy_confirm_message: An initially identical copy will be created. Do this only if you need to add, remove, or reorder songs without changing the official songbook.
songbook_page.custom_copy_tooltip: This is your personal copy; you can modify it without changing the recommended songbook.
